exposure: gestational weight gain (weekly weight gain during second/third trimesters)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 7,669 women who delivered at the Perinatal Center for Maternity and Neonatal, Yokohama City University Medical Center, between January 2001 and December 2012, stratified by pre-pregnancy BMI.
finding: In obese and overweight women, incidences of PIH, GDM, LGA, preterm birth, PPROM, and spontaneous preterm birth were significantly higher than in normal weight women, and pregnancy outcomes in obese women were difficult to improve with gestational weight control.
